map.基于五大自由原则对养殖场动物福利进行多维度评分（基于 Welfare Quali: Score farm-animal welfare across dimensions based on the Five Freedoms (simplified Welfare Quality)
map.五大自由原则：1.免受饥渴；2.免受不适；3.免受疼痛/伤病；4.表达正常行为；: The Five Freedoms: 1. from hunger and thirst; 2. from discomfort; 3. from pain/injury; 4. to express normal behavior; 5. from fear and stress. Scoring needs real observation plus quantitative indicators.
map.一维由 7 降到 4：综合分降至约 81 分，定位该维度为短板。: One dimension drops from 7 to 4: composite falls to about 81, flagging that dimension as the weak point.
map.每维 0~10，综合换算 0~100 分；≥85 优秀、70~85 良好。: Each dimension 0–10, composite scaled to 0–100; ≥85 excellent, 70–85 good.
map.按标准（如 Welfare Quality）设维度权重，可调整。: Set dimension weights by a standard (e.g., Welfare Quality); adjustable.
